prompts.name: infatuation
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Completely reimagine the tabletop RPG status icon INFATUATION. Attached flame is ONLY the graphic STYLE reference: match its bold thick dark contours, saturated colors, rich clean layered DRAWN shadows and broad sharp highlights, no painterly texture. New concept: an expressive large rose-pink HEART, slightly tilted, pierced diagonally by a small elegant ivory-and-rose Cupid ARROW, with a single deep-pink satin ribbon curling loosely around the lower heart and arrow shaft. Clearly conveys romantic enchantment / infatuation at a glance. Heart is the dominant silhouette, recognizable two lobes with sculpted rosy volume and cream pink reflections. Arrow has ONE clear simple arrowhead at one side, a small heart-shaped fletching at the opposite end; not a sword, not a wound, no blood. Ribbon is a broad soft flowing S-curve with a deliberate dark magenta outline, no bow or intricate knot; it gives a magical-love character without glitter. Charming fantasy game illustration with moderate controlled detail and dimensional drawn highlights. NO hypnotic spiral, no double spiral, no ornate filigree, no diamonds, tiny sparkles, stars, floating dots, surrounding aura or text. Not flat emoji, not a photoreal render or painted illustration. Entire compact composition centered within square canvas with comfortable margins. True transparent background.

prompts.name: hunters_mark
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Completely reimagine the tabletop RPG status icon HUNTER'S MARK. Attached flame is GRAPHIC STYLE reference ONLY: match its thick dark colored outlines, clean rich dimensional drawn shading, saturated colors and crisp broad highlights, no painterly texture. New concept: a large clearly readable GOLDEN-ORANGE ANIMAL PAW PRINT precisely targeted by a red-orange circular HUNTING RETICLE. No wolf head, skull, face or fur. Paw has one broad sculpted central pad and four rounded toe pads with subtle small pointed claw tips, all strongly outlined in dark brown, with amber shadows and cream-gold broad highlights. A deep burnt-orange round aiming ring surrounds the paw with four short cardinal inward ticks; leave transparent space so pads and ring remain clearly separated. Ring darker and redder than the bright gold paw. Visually conveys tracking and marking prey, reads as a hunting target rather than a generic pet-care logo. Moderate fantasy-game illustrative richness and drawn depth; not flat minimalist pictogram or realistic material. No scratches, blood, arrow, stars, glitter, haze, scattered particles, background, additional badge or text. Full compact design centered on square canvas with comfortable margins and genuine transparent background.
